apiContracts: The existing leaderboard API accepts weekly, monthly and all periods and safely normalizes unsupported periods to all-time.
Novel and author rankings use chapter-unlock events in the selected period, with all-time when no bounded window is selected.
Only published novels with original, public-domain, licensed or authorized rights status and published chapters contribute to rankings.
The API identifies rankingMetric as chapter_unlocks; zero-unlock novels are not padded into the ranked novel list.
No route signature or response ownership rule is changed by this UI and query-index slice.
dataEntities: Existing novels, chapters and unlocks tables only; no new persistent entity.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuses existing unlocks and chapters tables; runtime bootstrap adds an idempotent non-destructive composite index.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: No API shape or numbered migration change. Existing unlock records remain intact.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Code rollback removes the UI presentation and bootstrap index declaration; no data rewrite is required.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Leaderboard cards state the selected-period chapter-unlock metric and display the returned unlock counts.

privacySecurity.authentication: Existing public leaderboard read behavior is unchanged.
privacySecurity.authorization: No new route or write operation.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Only aggregate public rankings of published rights-cleared works are returned.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: Existing read limits and query behavior remain unchanged.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Unpublished and rights-ineligible works remain excluded.

integration: Existing leaderboard API regression plus visible metric/count assertions, runtime index presence and served bundle parity.
isolation: No new user-owned data access or writes.

stagingSteps: Verify weekly, monthly and all-time labels and counts against API unlock totals.
Confirm zero-unlock works are not presented as ranked results.
Verify source and versioned browser bundles are byte-identical.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert the leaderboard UI, test additions and bootstrap index declaration together.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No numbered migration or data mutation; an unused SQLite index may safely remain if already created.

collisionReview.duplicateRoutes: No route added; existing leaderboard page and API are reused.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Discovery owns ranking semantics; experience shell owns presentation; platform quality owns regression tests; architecture contract records shared-surface impact.

changeSummary: Align leaderboard UI with its existing period-scoped chapter-unlock ranking, display returned unlock counts, and add an idempotent chapter/time lookup index.
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly, monthly and all-time tabs explain that ordering is based on chapter unlocks in the selected period.
Novel and author cards display the API-returned period unlock counts.
Canonical ten-point rating formatting is preserved.
The runtime bootstrap creates idx_unlocks_chapter_time on unlocks(chapter_id,unlocked_at).
The regression checks API eligibility, period boundaries, zero-unlock suppression, metric labels, unlock counts, index presence and byte-identical browser bundles.
No numbered migration, route signature change, production data mutation or deployment is introduced.
